note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A): every expect and until is derived by hand from the 24-wire printed topology (no erratum applies) and the p.45 rule, not printed. Topology: the wiper D16 is on the plus rail (D16/M+); each output light n has nA on a rotary net and nB on the minus rail; the nets are D0-D3-D10 light 3, D1-D12 light 1, D2-D11-D15 light 2, D4-D9 light 4, D5-D8-D14 light 5, D6-D13 light 6, and D7 is unwired; D17/M+ and D18/M- run the motor toward increasing numbers whenever the dial is not held. One revolution therefore lights 3 1 2 3 4 5 6 (dark) 5 4 3 2 1 6 5 2 for contacts 0 to 15, one light at a time, and no two adjacent contacts share a light. Script choices, not printed: holding the knob at 0 through power on (the page prints no start position; 0 is the construction state), the 500 ms and 1500 ms held settles, the hand move to 7 to show the dark contact at rest, and the 3000 ms until windows (over two revolutions at 45 rpm). Not asserted: which lights are off during motion (a light just left is still cooling and reads dim, a thermal-model matter the topology does not settle), the gaps between pads, and run speed. Rotary geometry, run rate and the D17 +/D18 - direction rest on O-R1, O-R3 and O-R11.
